passages.text:
Nobody at CMU really believes the stories about the haunted mansion at the edge of the city.

The mansion has been abandoned for decades. People say strange voices can be heard from the place.

So, naturally, your friends decide to visit.

You arrive just before sunset.

The front door is already open.

[[Enter the mansion->Entrance Hall]]

[[Suggest going back->Turn Back]]
passages.name: Start

passages.text:
The door shuts behind you.

It won't open again.

For one second, you see a tall figure standing upstairs.

You hear footsteps from above you.

[[Go upstairs->Upstairs Hall]]

[[Search the ground floor->Library]]
passages.name: Entrance Hall

passages.text:
"This is a bad idea," you say.

Remina looks back toward the forest.

The path is gone.

You hear a loud noise from the mansion.

BANG.

Lev looks at the open door.

"I guess we're going in."

[[Enter the mansion->Entrance Hall]]
passages.name: Turn Back

passages.text:
Upstairs Hall

You see an old portrait of a boy at the end of the hall.

The boy's painted eyes seem to point toward a nearby door.

[[Open the door->Child Room]]

[[Go back downstairs->Library]]
passages.name: Upstairs Hall

passages.text:
The library is covered in dust.

Lev finds a small key inside a desk.

On the wall, someone carved:

DON'T LET IT SEE YOUR FACE.

Then something begins dragging itself through the hallway.

[[Hide->Hide in Library]]

[[Run->Hallway Chase]]
passages.name: Library

passages.text:
You turn off your flashlights.

Something enters the room.

It is tall and thin, with arms almost reaching the floor.

Its face splits open, rows of teeth appearing from inside.

Ivan screams.

[[Help Ivan->Save Ivan]]

[[Run while it's distracted->Basement Door]]
passages.name: Hide in Library

passages.text:
You sprint down the hallway.

The creature crawls after you on all fours.

At the end is a staircase leading down.

[[Run downstairs->Basement]]
passages.name: Hallway Chase

passages.text:
You hear Ivan screaming behind you.

But you keep running.

You reach the basement with Remina and Lev.

There is a generator beside a narrow service tunnel.

The creature is getting closer.

[[Start the generator->Escape Alone Ending]]

[[Open the iron door->Wrong Door Ending]]
passages.name: Basement Door

passages.text:
You pull Ivan away.

"RUN!"

The four of you escape through a door at the back of the library.

It leads downstairs.

[[Go to the basement->Basement]]
passages.name: Save Ivan

passages.text:
Basement

The basement is made of old stone.

At the center stands a huge iron door covered in chains.

Nearby is an old generator.

Leo looks at the key.

The creature is coming.

[[Start the generator->Generator]]

[[Open the iron door->Wrong Door Ending]]
passages.name: Basement

passages.text:
Inside is an old bedroom.

You find a journal.

One page is still readable:

"The thing in the cellar copies voices. It copies faces. We should never have opened the door. "

A voice comes from the hallway.

"Guys?"

It sounds exactly like Remina.

But Remina is standing beside you.

[[Run->Basement]]

[[Hide in the room->Bad Ending - Bedroom]]
passages.name: Child Room

passages.text:
You lock the door.

Suddenly, you hear a little crackling from behind you.

You turn.

Remina is uncannily smiling .

ENDING: THE WRONG REMINA

[[Restart->Start]]
passages.name: Bad Ending - Bedroom

passages.text:
The generator starts.

The tunnel opens.

You, Remina, and Lev escape.

Ivan does not.

Days later, police search the forest.

They find no mansion.

Three weeks later, your phone receives a message from Ivan's number.

Only two words:

COME BACK.

ENDING: SOMEONE WAS LEFT BEHIND

[[Restart->Start]]
passages.name: Escape Alone Ending

passages.text:
You place the key into the iron door.

The chains fall away.

The door slowly opens.

Something enormous moves in the darkness.

You realize the truth.

The lights go out.

ENDING: YOU RELEASED IT

[[Restart->Start]]
passages.name: Wrong Door Ending

passages.text:
You pull the starter.

Nothing.

Again.

The basement door shakes.

BANG.

You pull one more time.

The generator starts.

A hidden service tunnel opens.

The creature crashes into the basement.

You all run.

Hours later, you reach a road.

When you look back, the mansion is gone.

ENDING: ESCAPED

[[Restart->Start]]
passages.name: Generator
